h2.title: When is a vintage comparison meaningful?

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.purpose: When is a vintage comparison meaningful??
h3.formula: A comparison requires compatible economic concept, unit, population/frame and—when paired—authenticated record key.
h3.reader_explanation: A difference between two extracts is informative only after we know what each extract represents.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
